name: Pick n Pay Stores Limited
note: Listed on the JSE and A2X; the Group comprises subsidiaries that engage in the retail of food, groceries and general merchandise (Group Annual Financial Statements 2026). The founding Ackerman family's voting interest reduced from approximately 49.0% to 36.8% in FY26 (Integrated Annual Report 2026); press reporting on the November 2025 share placement says the family remains the retailer's anchor shareholder.
